newsitem.title: UK: IES sees operating loss in first half.
newsitem.headline: IES sees operating loss in first half.

text.p: Electronic security and information technology group IES Group Plc said on Tuesday that it is likely it will make an operating loss in the first half of the year.
"As a result of the level of sales being lower than originally budgeted, it is likely that the company will make an operating loss in the first half of the year to March 31, 1997," said IES.
It also warned that both turnover and operating profit for the current year may fall short of current market expectations.
The company is due to announce half year results on June 26.
By 1555 GMT, shares in AIM-listed IES had fallen 7-1/2p to stand at 120p.
